tasks.title: Security: callout theming
tasks.description: OWASP-aligned adversarial security gate for SPEC-0004: theme JSON parsing (bounded/strict deserialization), PNG validation, path traversal in imagePath, font-family handling, no new network surface, editor file pickers. Write docs/security/SEC-0004-theming.md.
tasks.notes: Gate PASS — no high/critical findings. Path traversal, PNG validation ordering, JSON deserialization safety, font-family handling, file-picker write containment, and no-new-network-calls were each adversarially tested and held. One MEDIUM finding spawned as TASK-022 (theme.json has no file-size cap before File.ReadAllText/JsonDocument.Parse — local resource-exhaustion DoS via a planted oversized file in the user-writable themes folder). Also flagged a process gap for the orchestrator: TASK-017 (QA) still shows status=failed with no recorded re-run after TASK-021 landed; TASK-019 (review) depends on TASK-017 and TASK-018 both and should not proceed until QA's gate is independently re-confirmed green.

tasks.title: Code: cap theme.json file size before read/parse
tasks.description: Per docs/security/SEC-0004-theming.md finding #1 (MEDIUM): ThemeLoader.LoadOneFolder and ThemeLoader.ReseedBuiltInIfNeeded call File.ReadAllText(manifestPath) with no upstream file-size check, unlike the PNG validator's enforced 2MB cap checked via FileInfo.Length before any read. Add an explicit small cap (e.g. 64 KB) checked via FileInfo.Length before File.ReadAllText in both call sites; an oversized theme.json must quarantine that folder (LoadOneFolder) or skip reseed (ReseedBuiltInIfNeeded) exactly like a malformed manifest, never partially read or buffer the full oversized file. Add a ThemeLoaderTests case that plants an oversized theme.json fixture and asserts quarantine without a multi-MB read. Do not rely solely on JsonDocumentOptions.MaxDepth — that bounds nesting depth only, not a single large string/wide array, so it does not close this gap on its own. All SPEC-0004 SS8 acceptance criteria must still pass after this lands.
tasks.notes: 64KB FileInfo.Length cap added before File.ReadAllText at both ThemeLoader.LoadOneFolder and ReseedBuiltInIfNeeded; oversized manifests quarantine/skip-reseed without buffering. Verified by QA's third gate run and independently re-confirmed by the final reviewer.
